title: ap manifest
description: Agent-portable secrets manifest (project ap.toml or global manifest.toml)

scope.description: Where vars defined in this file are stored (declared once; not per-var)

bundles.description: Project manifest: capability bundles this repo uses

encryption.description: SOPS age key stored in 1Password (project manifests)

op_vault.description: 1Password vault name containing the age key

op_item.description: 1Password item name for the age key

hooks.description: Bind lifecycle events to named actions. after_set/after_unset default to sync inside a Trove checkout.

after_set.description: Action to run after ap set (fail closed). Use none to disable.

after_unset.description: Action to run after ap unset (fail closed). Use none to disable.

before_show.description: Action to run before ap show (fail open). Not bound by default.

value.description: Inline value in TOML (global secrets or public vars; project secrets use .ap/secrets.json via ap set; mutually exclusive with derive)

ask.description: Human/agent prompt when the secret is missing

docs.description: Documentation URL for obtaining this credential

derive.description: Runtime resolver for public vars (mutually exclusive with value)

vars.description: Env var keys in this capability bundle

ask.description: Umbrella prompt when bundle secrets are missing

docs.description: Documentation for setting up this bundle

prompt.description: Agent instructions when using this bundle

run.description: Command argv to run for this action
